descriptor_v1.description: Generate the complete Cheminee descriptor_v1 contract in process.

CommitType.description: Specifies if the ingest request should block waiting for the records to be committed.

maturation_period.description:
Duration relative to `split.created_timestamp` after which a split
becomes mature.
If `now() >= split.created_timestamp + maturation_period` then
the split is considered mature.

max_finalize_split_num_docs.description:
Splits with a number of docs higher than
`max_finalize_split_num_docs` will not be considered
for finalize split merge operations.

max_merge_factor.description: Maximum number of splits that can be merged together in a single merge operation.

max_merge_ops.description: Maximum number of merges that a given split should undergo.

merge_factor.description: Number of splits to merge together in a single merge operation.

DescriptorLayout.description: Storage layout for the numeric descriptor contract. Existing indexes remain flat.

DocMapping.description:
Defines how the document of an index should be parsed, tokenized, partitioned, indexed, and
stored.

field_mappings.description:
Defines the schema of ingested documents and describes how each field value should be
parsed, tokenized, indexed, and stored.

index_field_presence.description:
Whether to record the presence of the fields of each indexed document to allow `exists`
queries.

max_num_partitions.description: The maximum number of partitions that an indexer can generate.

partition_key.description: Expresses via a "mini-DSL" how to route documents to split partitions.

store_document_size.description: Whether to record and store the size (bytes) of each ingested document in a fast field.

store_source.description: Whether to store the original source documents in the doc store.

tag_fields.description:
Declares the low cardinality fields for which the values ​​are recorded directly in the
splits metadata.

timestamp_field.description:
Declares the field which contains the date or timestamp at which the document
was emitted.

tokenizers.description: A set of additional user-defined tokenizers to be used during indexing.

DocMappingUid.description: Unique identifier for a document mapping.

FieldMappingEntryForSerialization.description:
A `FieldMappingEntry` defines how a field is indexed, stored,
and mapped from a JSON document to the related index fields.

Property parameters which defines the way the value must be indexed.

Properties are determined by the specified type, for more information
please see: <https://quickwit.io/docs/configuration/index-config#field-types>

name.description: Field name in the index schema.

IndexStats.description: Describes an index with its main information and statistics.

split_num_docs_target.description:
The merge policy aims to eventually produce mature splits that have a larger size but
are within close range of `split_num_docs_target`.

In other words, splits that contain a number of documents greater than or equal to
`split_num_docs_target` are considered mature and never merged.

min_shards.description: Configures the minimum number of shards to use for ingestion.

validate_docs.description:
Whether to validate documents against the current doc mapping during ingestion.
Defaults to true. When false, documents will be written directly to the WAL without
validation, but might still be rejected during indexing when applying the doc mapping
in the doc processor, in that case the documents are dropped and a warning is logged.

Note that when a source has a VRL transform configured, documents are not validated against
the doc mapping during ingestion either.

client_log_level.description: Kafka client log level. Possible values are `debug`, `info`, `warn`, and `error`.

enable_backfill_mode.description: When backfill mode is enabled, the source exits after reaching the end of the topic.

topic.description: Name of the topic that the source consumes.

enable_backfill_mode.description: When backfill mode is enabled, the source exits after reaching the end of the stream.

ModeType.description: Defines how unmapped fields should be handled.

credentials_file.description:
GCP service account credentials (`None` will use default via
GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS)
Path to a google_cloud_auth::credentials::CredentialsFile serialized in JSON. See also
`<https://cloud.google.com/docs/authentication/application-default-credentials>` and
`<https://github.com/yoshidan/google-cloud-rust/tree/main/pubsub#automatically>` and
`<https://docs.rs/google-cloud-auth/0.12.0/google_cloud_auth/credentials/struct.CredentialsFile.html>`.

enable_backfill_mode.description: When backfill mode is enabled, the source exits after reaching the end of the topic.

max_messages_per_pull.description: Maximum number of messages returned by a pull request (default 1,000)

project_id.description: GCP project ID (Defaults to credentials file project ID).

subscription.description: Name of the subscription that the source consumes.

consumer_name.description: The name to register with the pulsar source.

topics.description: List of the topics that the source consumes.

QuickwitJsonOptions.description:
Options associated to a json field.

`QuickwitJsonOptions` is also used to configure
the dynamic mapping.

expand_dots.description: If true, the '.' in json keys will be expanded.

indexed.description: If true, all of the element in the json object will be indexed.

stored.description: If true, the field will be stored in the doc store.

num_docs_for_processing.description: Number of rows in the request payload

num_rejected_docs.description: Number of docs rejected because of parsing errors

parse_failures.description:
Detailed description of parsing errors (available if the query param
`detailed_response` is set to `true`)

period.description:
Duration of time for which the splits should be retained, expressed in a human-friendly way
(`1 hour`, `3 days`, `1 week`, ...).

schedule.description:
Defines the frequency at which the retention policy is evaluated and applied, expressed in
a human-friendly way (`hourly`, `daily`, ...) or as a cron expression (`0 0 * * * *`,
`0 0 0 * * *`).

SplitInfo.description: A summarized version of the split metadata for display purposes.

file_name.description: The name of the split file on disk.

file_size_bytes.description: The size of the split file on disk in bytes.

num_docs.description: The number of documents in the split.

uncompressed_docs_size_bytes.description: The sum of the sizes of the original JSON payloads in bytes.

maturation_period.description:
Duration relative to `split.created_timestamp` after which a split
becomes mature.
If `now() >= split.created_timestamp + maturation_period` then
the split is mature.

max_merge_factor.description: Maximum number of splits that can be merged together in a single merge operation.

merge_factor.description: Number of splits to merge together in a single merge operation.

min_level_num_docs.description: Number of docs below which all splits are considered as belonging to the same level.

TokenizerEntry.description: A `TokenizerEntry` defines a custom tokenizer with its name and configuration.

script.description:
[VRL] source code of the transform compiled to a VRL [`Program`](vrl::compiler::Program).

[VRL]: https://vector.dev/docs/reference/vrl/

timezone.description:
Timezone used in the VRL [`Program`](vrl::compiler::Program) for date and time
manipulations. Defaults to `UTC` if not timezone is specified.

parameters.description: The index ID to add docs to.

requestBody.description: Raw newline-delimited JSON documents, not a JSON-encoded string. Limited by the configured ingestion body size.

200.description: Batch response. Individual documents may be rejected; inspect num_ingested_docs and num_rejected_docs. Missing counts mean acceptance is unknown, not zero. Acknowledgement does not imply search visibility with commit=auto.

503.description: Ingestion unavailable or timed out; a late append may still occur. Do not blindly retry.
